      About

      I design brand systems that hold together, even when other people are producing.

      I've designed for magazines, salsa makers, pastry shops, a coffee roaster, a patient app and a US marketing agency, usually from the seat between the creative work and the people who have to sell it.

      That middle seat taught me to explain design decisions in plain language and to defend the ones that matter, which turns out to be most of what leading a team asks for. I've done it with teams of two and three designers.

      I also write my own copy, in Spanish and English, so the words and the layout get designed together instead of one waiting on the other. My production workflow folds in AI tools like Midjourney, Firefly and Claude where they save time, and leaves them out where they flatten the work.
